answers.core: In my experience as an environment artist I have worked with multiple engines. Both publicly available and in-house.I never worked on a 3d project that does not require vertex color for some aspect of the workflow.
answers.workaround: It could be, but it will be ugly and not performant. The best way would be to be a part of either the MeshInstance3D or the mesh resource itself.
